What Enchants Go on What Gear ​

Here is the simple list showing every custom enchant in the game, where it goes, and what it does in plain English.

Helmets ​

Put these enchants on any helmet:

EnchantMax LevelRarityWhat It Does
NightsightLevel 1CommonGives you permanent Night Vision so you can see in the dark.
GourmandLevel 2CommonSlowly fills your food bar so you never starve.
ClarityLevel 2CommonStops you from getting blinded by squids or wardens.
InsightLevel 3RareLets you see glowing sparkles around invisible players.
ProtectionLevel 4VanillaMakes you take less damage from all attacks.
RespirationLevel 3VanillaLets you breathe underwater much longer.
Aqua AffinityLevel 1VanillaLets you mine underwater at normal speed.
UnbreakingLevel 3VanillaMakes your helmet last way longer before breaking.
MendingLevel 1VanillaXP orbs repair your helmet automatically.

Chestplates ​

Put these enchants on any chestplate:

EnchantMax LevelRarityWhat It Does
OverloadLevel 2Super RareGives you 1 to 2 permanent extra red hearts!
IroncladLevel 2RareStops enemies from knocking you back when they hit you.
DeflectionLevel 3RareGives you a chance to bounce away incoming arrows with zero damage.
Inferno PlatingLevel 3RareSets attackers on fire when they hit you with a sword.
PurityLevel 2CommonMakes you immune to poison and wither effects.
ProtectionLevel 4VanillaMakes you take less damage from all hits.
ThornsLevel 3VanillaHurts enemies back when they attack you.
UnbreakingLevel 3VanillaMakes your chestplate last way longer.
MendingLevel 1VanillaXP orbs repair your chestplate.

Pants (Leggings) ​

Put these enchants on any pair of leggings:

EnchantMax LevelRarityWhat It Does
EvasionLevel 3RareGives you a chance to dodge sword attacks completely.
AdrenalineLevel 3RareGives you a speed boost when someone hits you so you can escape.
RejuvenationLevel 2RareSlowly heals your hearts after you avoid taking damage for a few seconds.
ProtectionLevel 4VanillaReduces all incoming damage.
Swift SneakLevel 3VanillaLets you walk fast while crouching.
UnbreakingLevel 3VanillaMakes your pants last way longer.
MendingLevel 1VanillaXP orbs repair your pants.

Boots ​

Put these enchants on any boots:

EnchantMax LevelRarityWhat It Does
SwiftnessLevel 2CommonMakes you run faster all the time.
SpringsLevel 2CommonLets you jump higher all the time.
StompLevel 2RareTakes less fall damage and creates a ground slam that hurts nearby mobs.
Feather FallingLevel 4VanillaReduces fall damage so you do not die from high drops.
Depth StriderLevel 3VanillaLets you swim and walk through water at normal walking speed.
Soul SpeedLevel 3VanillaLets you run super fast on soul sand.
ProtectionLevel 4VanillaReduces all incoming damage.
UnbreakingLevel 3VanillaMakes your boots last way longer.
MendingLevel 1VanillaXP orbs repair your boots.

Swords ​

Put these enchants on your swords:

EnchantMax LevelRarityWhat It Does
Life StealLevel 3Super RareSteals health from enemies and gives you extra golden hearts.
BleedLevel 3Super RareMakes enemies bleed and take damage every second.
TriumphLevel 3Super RareHeals your hearts instantly whenever you defeat an enemy.
BerserkerLevel 1Super RareGives you super strength and speed when you are low on hearts.
ThunderstrikeLevel 3RareSummons a lightning bolt from the sky to zap your target.
ExecutionerLevel 3RareDoes massive extra damage to enemies that are low on health.
BackstabLevel 3RareDoes bonus damage when you hit someone from behind.
BloodlustLevel 3RareHits do more damage each time you hit without missing.
Wither BladeLevel 3RareGives enemies the black wither effect when you hit them.
BlindingLevel 2RareBlinds your target so they cannot see you for a moment.
VenomLevel 3CommonPoisons enemies on hit.
FrostbiteLevel 3CommonFreezes enemies with Slowness so they cannot run away.
WisdomLevel 3CommonGives you way more XP orbs when killing mobs.
FeastLevel 3CommonFills your food bar when you kill a mob.
SharpnessLevel 5VanillaMakes your sword do more damage on every hit.
Fire AspectLevel 2VanillaSets mobs on fire when you hit them.
LootingLevel 3VanillaMakes mobs drop way more items.
UnbreakingLevel 3VanillaMakes your sword last way longer.
MendingLevel 1VanillaXP orbs repair your sword.

Axes ​

Put these enchants on your battle axes:

EnchantMax LevelRarityWhat It Does
CleaveLevel 3Super RareHits all nearby enemies in front of you in one big swing.
UppercutLevel 2RareLaunches enemies flying high up into the air.
SunderLevel 3RareBreaks down the enemy's armor durability faster.
TelekinesisLevel 1CommonCut wood goes directly into your inventory instead of falling.
EfficiencyLevel 5VanillaCuts down trees super fast.
SharpnessLevel 5VanillaIncreases axe melee damage.

Bows & Crossbows ​

Put these enchants on your bows:

EnchantWeaponRarityWhat It Does
Exploding ArrowsBow & CrossbowSuper RareArrows explode on impact like TNT.
VolleyBow & CrossbowSuper RareShoots multiple extra arrows in a spread.
HeadshotBowRareDoes huge bonus damage if you hit the enemy in the head.
MarksmanBowRareDoes more damage the farther away your target is.
LevitateBowRareMakes your target float up into the sky when hit.
HarpoonCrossbowRarePulls enemies straight toward you like a grappling hook.
ConservationBow & CrossbowCommonGives you a chance to shoot without using up your arrows.
TracerBow & CrossbowCommonMakes targets glow through walls for a few seconds.
PowerBowVanillaMakes your arrows hit much harder.
InfinityBowVanillaShoot unlimited arrows as long as you have 1 arrow.

Pickaxes & Shovels ​

Put these enchants on your mining tools:

EnchantToolRarityWhat It Does
ExcavatorPickaxe & ShovelSuper RareMines out a big 3x3 square of blocks in one single swing!
SmeltingPickaxeCommonAutomatically turns iron and gold ore into cooked ingots.
TelekinesisPickaxe & ShovelCommonMined ores and blocks fly directly into your inventory.
HastePickaxe & ShovelCommonGives you the Haste mining speed boost while holding it.
EfficiencyPickaxe & ShovelVanillaMines blocks way faster.
FortunePickaxe & ShovelVanillaGives you more diamonds, coal, and lapis per ore block.
Silk TouchPickaxe & ShovelVanillaDrops the exact block (like glass, ice, or stone).

Maces (Minecraft 1.21) ​

Put these enchants on the heavy mace:

EnchantRarityWhat It Does
Gravity WellSuper RarePulls all nearby players and mobs toward where you slam down.
AftershockRareCreates a ground shockwave that slows down anyone near your hit.
Wind BurstVanillaBounces you back up into the air when you hit someone from above.
DensityVanillaDoes way more damage the higher up you fall from.
BreachVanillaIgnores a chunk of the enemy's armor so your hit hurts more.
